src: The tumour cells have pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, raisinoid nuclei and perinuclear halos; CK7 is diffusely positive and CD117 is positive, favouring chromophobe renal cell carcinoma over oncocytoma.
TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma and FH-deficient renal cell carcinoma are molecularly defined subtypes in the 2022 WHO classification.
Any sarcomatoid or rhabdoid differentiation assigns WHO/ISUP grade 4, even when it is focal.
The Wilms tumour was triphasic, with blastemal, epithelial and stromal components, and showed no anaplasia (favourable histology).
A radical nephrectomy was performed; the tumour thrombus extended into the renal vein but not into the inferior vena cava.
Urothelial carcinoma of the renal pelvis must be distinguished from collecting duct carcinoma; GATA3 positivity favours a urothelial origin.
The renal biopsy contained 18 glomeruli, 3 of them globally sclerosed; two glomeruli had cellular crescents and one had a fibrous crescent.
Light microscopy showed mesangial hypercellularity, and immunofluorescence showed dominant mesangial IgA deposits, consistent with IgA nephropathy (Oxford MEST-C: M1 E0 S1 T0 C0).
Class IV lupus nephritis with wire-loop lesions and subendothelial deposits; activity index 12, chronicity index 2.
Electron microscopy showed diffuse foot process effacement without electron-dense deposits, consistent with minimal change disease.
Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, collapsing variant, was diagnosed in a patient with steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome.
